# ── Noēsis Wiki — MkDocs Material static site container ──────────────────────
# Builds wiki/ (markdown) → static HTML and serves it under /wiki/ via nginx.
# The single source of truth (design · planning · implementation · reference),
# reachable from the Noēsis top menu.
#
# Build (from repo root):  docker build -f docker/Dockerfile.wiki -t noesis-wiki .
# Run:                     docker run --rm -p 8089:80 noesis-wiki  →  http://localhost:8089/wiki/
FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
WORKDIR /build
# git: the git-revision-date plugin uses GitPython, which aborts at import if
# the git binary is absent. With git present + no .git in the build context,
# the plugin falls back to the build date (fallback_to_build_date in mkdocs.yml).
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
ENV GIT_PYTHON_REFRESH=quiet
COPY requirements-wiki.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-wiki.txt
COPY mkdocs.yml .
COPY wiki/ ./wiki/
# Non-strict build: links to not-yet-migrated docs are expected during migration.
RUN mkdocs build --site-dir /site

FROM nginx:1.27-alpine
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="Noesis Wiki"
LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="Single source of truth — MkDocs Material"

RUN rm -f /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
COPY docker/nginx.wiki.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/wiki.conf

# Serve the built site under /wiki/ (matches the nginx proxy route).
COPY --from=build /site /usr/share/nginx/html/wiki/

EXPOSE 80

HEALTHCHECK --interval=15s --timeout=4s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD wget -qO- http://127.0.0.1/healthz || exit 1
